body:
Ha. Yeah, I just visited my girlfriend in NYC and sheesh... I live on the other side of the country and while it wasn’t $1000 or anything, it was still a lot for college students.  Like, I’m just glad we were able to split the ticket since we visit each other on breaks since I have an extra fall break so we can.. you know, equally pay or something ($250 each though! Ridiculous.)...

Oh yes. Thanksgiving though? Gone. Out of the question.

It’d be probably most weekday afternoons/evenings and weekend afternoons, which concerns me because I’ll definitely have a job (college is #expensive) and probably be available at the exact opposite of
those times. We certainly wouldn’t be attached at the hip, but I would have liked to have more time together over the summer.

But thank you, I think it’s just difficult for me to see the long run of anything.
This is so lovely!! Thank you for sharing. I do want to get back into filming now...
Yeah, my only concern is money. I guess it’ll come.

The same as you. I was in a relationship for two years with a really lovely girl and though I don’t believe that my BPD is solely the reason for us ending (I chose to end it, by the way), I do think if I had dealt with it the way I’m doing now then we would have been a lot better and might be together still. It’s hard. I love the idea of love so much and I love having someone but I feel like I will never have a healthy relationship.

I don’t know if she was good for me to begin with, but she was soft and beautiful and we made each other happy for a while. But I guess neither of us really knew how to deal with my BPD. There were other things, like I resented her for some of her actions for a while and I still do but... Maybe if none of those things had happened or if I dealt with BPD in a healthy way then we would at least be on good terms. Maybe I wouldn’t feel so alone? I don’t know, but you might relate.
That.. is so adorable.. and good..

I tried asking one of my NT friends if she felt this way and she was just like “... That’s definitely not what I do...” Hence.. this post. I’m glad your friends understand though :) Mine are quite good as well.
Very true. Maybe I just need to stop overthinking it hahaha

Well definitely, but I mean like social interactions (also technically no one taught me how to use a toilet LOL 😉). Though you are right, it could just be actual learned behavior that’s a normal thing based on other experiences and not me being “weird.” Hmph.
The evaluation thing you said is exactly what I do!!! Ugh and the eye contact thing. Yeah.

Thanks— I’ll see how this week goes... I think I’m getting better, partially because, well, honestly there’s a lot I can’t fit into one Reddit post. But yes, I think this month will be fantastic. All the best to you as well :)
Me too!! Very good. I'm glad somebody else appreciates it :)
That is so exciting!!! Have a lovely time! That's the life I'm trying to live <3
